Lead form: filled name+email+style=Japandi, submitted → id-form-success success block rendered; style dropdown had exactly the 12 new styles (Warm Minimalism, Japandi, Organic Modern, Quiet Luxury, Modern Mediterranean, Scandinavian Contemporary, Contemporary Industrial, Modern Classic, Biophilic Design, Wabi Sabi Contemporary, Themed Design, Eclectic). Landing page /: 'Servicii' dropdown shows 'Interior Intelligence' as first entry. AI assistant (id-assistant-fab): opens panel, sent test question 'Ce buget e realist pentru un living de 25mp?', received 863-char Romanian response in 11.6s with concrete budget tiers (Economic/Mediu/Premium) — well within <20s target. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/interior_design.py:30 — _get_content() runs a migration write on every GET when the DB doc has content_version<2. Under normal load this only fires once (until doc is saved). But: if two concurrent requests race after a fresh deploy where service_pages has content_version=1, both will fire the update_one and both will duplicate the log line + trigger dual-write to interior_design_content. Idempotent so no data corruption, but consider a startup one-shot migration to `_get_content` instead of lazy per-request.

routes/interior_design.py:196-210 — PUT admin content: `allowed` set for keys includes 'seo_article','hero','styles_showcase','digital_twin','audit','implementation','ecosystem','process_phases','positioning','brand','journey'? Actually the set only allows {'active','show_on_homepage','menu_order','seo','hero','benefits','steps','portfolio','reviews','faq','styles','budgets','local_cities','related_services','seo_article'} — meaning admin CANNOT edit new v2-only keys via PUT: brand, positioning, journey, process_phases, digital_twin, audit, implementation, styles_showcase, ecosystem. If the product intent is 'CMS-driven', this is a functional gap for content editors. LOW priority for now (defaults are fine) but should be extended.

routes/interior_design.py:76-89 — _triage_lead() scoring is purely deterministic on 'peste' keyword in budget. But v2 budgets list uses '5.000 – 15.000 lei','15.000 – 40.000 lei','40.000 – 100.000 lei','peste 100.000 lei'. Only the last matches the +25 branch; 15k-40k and 40k-100k fall to +15. Consider matching digit-range boundaries (extract high number) rather than string tokens for consistency with new budget copy.

InteriorDesignLanding.jsx:181 — ld = document.createElement('script'); ld.id='id-jsonld'; document.head.appendChild(ld). On dev hot reload the cleanup (line 201 return ()=>document.getElementById('id-jsonld')?.remove()) is fine, but if content mutates twice quickly, two scripts could momentarily coexist. Consider setting via document.getElementById first and reusing.

InteriorDesignLanding.jsx:132-135 — <select data-testid='id-form-style'> uses `content.styles` (12 items) but content also has `styles_showcase.items` (12 rich objects). Consistent, but if either drifts, the dropdown will not match the showcase. Prefer deriving the select from styles_showcase.items[*].name so a single source of truth.

InteriorDesignLanding.jsx:107-114 — After successful submit the form is replaced by success block with no CTA to submit another. Fine for a lead form but worth noting UX-wise; also `sent` state doesn't clear form data so if user refreshes-and-navigates state is lost — acceptable.
service_content_design.py — DEFAULT_CONTENT has 'related_services' key referenced in `allowed` PUT set but no such key exists in DEFAULT_CONTENT. Harmless (extra allowed key), but dead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids + AI assistant + form submit verified)

Watch-outs: (1) Backend `_triage_lead` uses string-token matching on budget — the new v2 budgets '5.000 – 15.000 lei'/'15.000 – 40.000 lei' fall into the +15 (not +25) branch because 'peste' keyword is the only high signal. (2) AI assistant endpoint has per-IP rate limit 10 req/10min — one question per test run is fine, but a repeated CI run could exhaust the window. (3) The unified `leads` collection lowercases email; assert case-insensitively. (4) Admin PUT `allowed` set does NOT include v2-only keys (brand, positioning, journey, process_phases, digital_twin, audit, implementation, styles_showcase, ecosystem) — future CMS-editor UI must extend this whitelist or PUTs will 400 silently. (5) content_version migration only fires when service_pages doc has version<2; if you need to force a re-migration, delete the service_pages 'design-interior' doc.
